select h.* from z000_sd_pay_receipt_header h

order by h.create_time desc
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO z000_sd_pay_receipt_header (receipt_id, cmpy, cstc, bstp, buss_date, buss_status, router_code, title, remark, user_id, curr, pay_nature, pay_way, cust, text, prfc, bank_doc, amt_receipt, my_acc_no, pay_acc_no, pay_acc_name, summary, create_by, create_time) values (#{receiptId}, #{cmpy}, #{cstc}, #{bstp}, #{bussDate}, #{bussStatus}, #{routerCode}, #{title}, #{remark}, #{userId}, #{curr}, #{payNature}, #{payWay}, #{cust}, #{text}, #{prfc}, #{bankDoc}, #{amtReceipt}, #{myAccNo}, #{payAccNo}, #{payAccName}, #{summary}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update z000_sd_pay_receipt_header set cmpy = #{cmpy}, cstc = #{cstc}, bstp = #{bstp}, buss_date = #{bussDate}, buss_status = #{bussStatus}, router_code = #{routerCode}, title = #{title}, remark = #{remark}, user_id = #{userId}, curr = #{curr}, pay_nature = #{payNature}, pay_way = #{payWay}, cust = #{cust}, text = #{text}, prfc = #{prfc}, bank_doc = #{bankDoc}, amt_receipt = #{amtReceipt}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} where receipt_id = #{receiptId}
